laws_pinned: THE SUFFIX LAW: the dispatch layer normalizes registry keys to workflow file names — a registry key is a BOOK identity, a workflow file name is an API identity; the two shapes must never be conflated at an API boundary
THE WIRE-NAME FLOOR: every desk the keeper watches must resolve to a workflow file that EXISTS on the tree — a watched desk that cannot be fired is a lie the arc book would green-wash

THE DORMANT-BACKUP LAW (verified, R75): a private workflow with 0 successes ever is legal ONLY when its comment books the decision AND its public twin demonstrably carries the load — both conditions measured this rung
